lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: An irregular distribution of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, displaying a transition from high-density, small-diameter clusters on the pectoral fin to a more regular, wider-spaced arrangement of larger spots along the mid-lateral body axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, creating a grid-like mesh where blobs are positioned at the approximate center of vertical-horizontal junctions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the flank, marked by a sharp shadow-to-light vertical gradient indicating a lateral ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of micro-luminance spots compared to the larger, more discrete spots found on the primary lateral flank.
